name: TCL
note: Al-Ittihad sponsor for two seasons from October 2025 (men's and women's first teams), signed through Alesayi Electronics, TCL's exclusive distributor in Saudi Arabia; the TCL logo sits on the right shoulder of the men's team jerseys. Unrated (changed back 2026-10-03 by BTJ Scout review): the ownership chain ends at TCL Industries Holdings Co., Ltd., a private PRC holding company whose own shareholders are not named in the sources opened (TCL Electronics IR FAQ; HKEX major-transaction announcement of 15 July 2026). Media reporting on that transaction (36kr/Damo Finance, 2026-07-17) describes TCL founder Li Dongsheng as the actual controller of TCL Electronics through TCL Industries, and says the 2019 restructuring introduced CITIC Industrial Fund as a shareholder of TCL Industries; no source opened gives the size or current status of that or any other stake in TCL Industries Holdings.
